lazy checked callbacks preserve iteration order and short circuiting; shared aggregate views require immutable descriptor-only runtime guards, while owned aggregate moves and consuming an iterator twice remain unsupported
every natural, integer and machine integer is a BigInt; machine-integer results are range-checked and throw RangeError where Rust would panic
